name: AI/BI Patient Genomics Review for Oncology
narrative:
You're a translational oncology lead deciding where a new targeted therapy, OncoTarget-1, actually belongs. Across a ~10,000-patient TCGA-style cohort the drug shows a modest overall survival benefit — but a flat average hides the truth, and using it everywhere would help some patients and harm others.

Ask Genie which subgroup benefits and the answer isn't an organ — it's a molecular signature. Within breast cancer a distinct gene-expression subtype (a tight cluster in the UMAP view) reaches ~99% two-year survival versus ~84-89% on standard of care, while the drug is not indicated for ovarian and prostate cancer, where treated patients do worse. Synthetic genomics data, a governed metric view, an AI/BI dashboard and Genie — precision oncology grounded in one lakehouse.
